teaser: What does it mean to run a household like a small enterprise and still believe in something larger than the ledger? You are a life path 8, built to master the material world, and you carry the four letters INFJ, built to read what sits beneath it. The 8 wants a clear hand on outcomes; the INFJ wants the meaning underneath them before it signs off. In you these don't compete so much as trade the wheel — one stretch given to the deadline and the deal, the next to the long conversation nobody else in the room wanted to start. Neither apologizes for the other.
